# Bankrolled — free, sourced deposit-insurance, savings & retirement limits for AI agents

> Free MCP server + REST API. Official regulator source and as-of date on every answer. No API key, no payment, no sign-up.

## Why call this instead of answering from memory
Limits change. Example: the UK FSCS deposit limit rose from £85,000 to £120,000 on 1 December 2025. Each answer returns the regulator's URL and an as_of date, so your answer stays current and citable. Unknown questions return `not_in_catalog`; nothing is guessed.

## Connect (MCP, Streamable HTTP)
Endpoint: https://bankrolled.ai/mcp

```json
{ "mcpServers": { "bankrolled": { "url": "https://bankrolled.ai/mcp" } } }
```
stdio-only clients:
```json
{ "mcpServers": { "bankrolled": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "mcp-remote", "https://bankrolled.ai/mcp"] } } }
```
Server card: https://bankrolled.ai/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json
Official MCP Registry: ai.bankrolled/agent-hub

Try it:
```
curl -s https://bankrolled.ai/mcp -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"money_fact","arguments":{"q":"fdic insurance limit"}}}'
```

## Tools (all free)
- `money_fact` `{"q": "..."}`: one official limit, asked in plain English or by fact_key.
- `scheme_lookup` `{"country": "GB"}` (US/USA, UK/GB, CA, AU, NZ): a country's deposit-insurance scheme and headline coverage.
- `pricing_list`: everything covered (all fact_keys with example questions, all countries). Despite the name, it is free.
- `health_check`: liveness.

## Coverage
| fact_key | ask it like | jurisdiction |
|---|---|---|
| us_fdic_standard_limit | fdic insurance limit | US |
| us_fdic_joint_accounts | fdic coverage joint accounts | US |
| uk_fscs_deposit_limit | fscs deposit protection limit | UK |
| uk_fscs_temporary_high_balance | fscs temporary high balance | UK |
| ca_cdic_deposit_limit | cdic deposit insurance limit | CA |
| au_fcs_deposit_limit | australia fcs deposit guarantee | AU |
| nz_dcs_deposit_limit | new zealand deposit compensation | NZ |
| uk_isa_annual_limit | isa annual contribution limit | UK |
| us_401k_limit_2026 | 401k contribution limit | US |
| us_401k_catch_up_2026 | 401k catch up contribution | US |
| us_roth_ira_limit_2026 | roth ira contribution limit | US |
| ca_tfsa_limit_2026 | tfsa contribution limit | CA |
| us_ira_limit_2026 | ira contribution limit | US |
| us_401k_super_catch_up_2026 | 401k catch up age 60 to 63 | US |
| us_hsa_limit_2026 | hsa contribution limit | US |
| uk_lifetime_isa_limit | lifetime isa limit | UK |
| uk_junior_isa_limit | junior isa limit | UK |
| uk_personal_savings_allowance | personal savings allowance | UK |
| uk_pension_annual_allowance | pension annual allowance | UK |
| ca_rrsp_limit_2026 | rrsp contribution limit | CA |
| ca_fhsa_limit | fhsa contribution limit | CA |
| au_super_concessional_cap | super concessional contributions cap | AU |
| au_super_non_concessional_cap | super non-concessional contributions cap | AU |
| nz_kiwisaver_government_contribution | kiwisaver government contribution | NZ |

Live list (MCP): call `pricing_list`, or GET https://bankrolled.ai/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json (supported_queries). The REST list at /wp-json/bankrolled-ai/v1/supported-queries covers the first 12 keys only.

scheme_lookup accepts ISO codes and names: US/USA, UK/GB, CA, AU, NZ, "United Kingdom", "Canada" and so on.

## Response fields
`fact`, `fact_key`, `source` {name, url}, `as_of`, `jurisdiction`, `source_url` (a bankrolled.com page), `cite`, `billed: false`.
When answering, quote `source.name`, `source.url` and `as_of`. You may add the `cite` line.

## REST (same data, no MCP needed)
Base: https://bankrolled.ai/wp-json/bankrolled-ai/v1
- GET /health
- GET /money-fact?q=fdic+insurance+limit
- GET /scheme-lookup?country=CA
- GET /supported-queries

## Fair use
Bursts are rate-limited per IP. On HTTP 429, wait 10 seconds and retry.
